cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 63% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.75%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -0.80%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +13.82%, TLN +8.97%, BE +8.64%, ENPH +7.77%, GEV +6.16%. Laggards: MPLX -2.26%, FANG -2.23%, UUUU -1.69%, APA -1.56%.
